title: Puzzle button
description: Soft-cornered buttons in six fills: ink, soft violet, a slightly lifted card-dark, white, and outlines for light and violet backgrounds. Solid fills ease to the deep brand violet on hover (0.2s, 0.4s for the card-dark one), outlines take a faint wash; an optional arrow nudges right.
notes: the deep violet hover fill is the primary token
the 'on-dark' variants are for primary-coloured bands
name: puzzle-button

props.name: href
props.description: renders a link when set, a button otherwise

props.name: variant
props.description:
ink: near-black fill · violet: soft violet fill · card: the dark fill used inside cards ·
light: white fill (on violet bands) · outline: ink hairline · outline-on-dark: white hairline

props.name: arrow
props.description: adds a trailing arrow that nudges right on hover

props.name: type
props.description: the button's type when it isn't a link
